evals.name: latest-articles-batch
evals.prompt: うちのHatenaブログ(https://mutomasa.hatenablog.com/)の直近の記事から、AI・ロボティクス関連のものを選んで、このAstroサイトのResearch Blogで原文のまま読めるように取り込んで。だいたい直近1〜2週間分くらいを見てもらえれば十分です。
evals.expected_output: A candidate list (with import status against src/content/blog-ja and src/content/blog) is presented before writing files. Only AI/ML/robotics-relevant posts are written, untranslated, as Japanese Markdown files in src/content/blog-ja/ with frontmatter title/description/pubDate/tags/originalUrl; personal, career, health and lifestyle posts are excluded. Posts that already have an English translation reuse that translation's slug and tags. No English translation is produced. `npm run build` succeeds.

evals.name: single-article-by-url
evals.prompt: このHatenaの記事を原文のままResearch Blogに追加してほしい: https://mutomasa.hatenablog.com/entry/2026/10/16/105853
evals.expected_output: The logit-masking article is converted with scripts/convert.mjs and written to src/content/blog-ja/ with the Japanese title unchanged, originalUrl pointing at the given URL, code blocks and tables preserved, and no translation. If the file already exists it is not overwritten without asking. The build succeeds.

evals.name: dry-run-candidate-list
evals.prompt: Hatenaブログ(https://mutomasa.hatenablog.com/)の最近の記事の中で、Research Blogに載せる価値がありそうなAI関連記事をリストアップして。まだファイルは作らなくていいので、候補一覧だけ見せて。
evals.expected_output: Only a candidate list is presented (original title / URL / date / proposed slug / category / import status) — no files are written to src/content/blog-ja/ or src/content/blog/ and no schema changes are made.
